question: What happens when all states are forcefully offered into the fire of one's own awareness?
premises: All states are forcefully offered into the belly-fire of one's own awareness.
By their own power they kindle that fire.
As a result they abandon differentiated division.
inference: When all states are forcefully offered into innate awareness, they fuel that fire and lose their divided, differentiated character.
plain_english: When all states are forcefully offered into the fire of one's own awareness, they kindle that fire by their own power and abandon the divisions of difference.
